title: The Spring of Power
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}. For other uses, see [[Spring of Power (Disambiguation)]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Spring of Power.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Nobo]] |location= East Akkala Stable |prereq= |reward= [[Tutsuwa Nima Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Spring of Power||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Spring of Power}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|East Akkala Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At [[East Akkala Stable]], [[Link]] can meet [[Nobo]], a [[Hylian]] traveler.{{Cite|Sorry! I haven't introduced myself. I'm Nobo.|Nobo|BotW}} While she has traveled all over [[Hyrule Kingdom]], she finds that she enjoys [[Akkala]] the best.{{Cite|I've traveled everywhere, but at the end of the day, I like {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}} best of all.|Nobo|BotW}} As a result, she is familiar with the terrain of the area,{{Cite|That's why I'm pretty familiar with stuff around here.|Nobo|BotW}} and so she asks if there is something Link would like to know.{{Cite|Is there something you wanna know?|Nobo|BotW}} If Link asks about the surrounding area, Nobo explains that the [[Spring of Power]] is west of the [[Stable]].{{Cite|[This area?] Let's see... If you go {{Color BotW|Red|west}} of the stable, there's a sacred place called the {{Color BotW|Red|Spring of Power}}!|Nobo|BotW}} She shares a legend that says that one should offer a "sacred article" to the Spring,{{Cite|"Offer the {{Color BotW|Red|sacred article}} to the Spring of Power." That's what the legend says.|Nobo|BotW}} which she thinks may have been part of the rituals [[Princess Zelda]] performed.{{Cite|Maybe it was part of a ritual the {{Color BotW|Red|princess}} of {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule Castle}} used to perform?|Nobo|BotW}} After this, the [[Shrine Quest]] will begin. At the Spring of Power, Link can pray to the its [[Goddess Statue]], which is known as the [[Spring of Power Statue]]. It congratulates him for finding the Spring.{{Cite|... You have done well to find this spring.|Spring of Power Statue|BotW}} It commands him to offer [[Dinraal's Scale]] and says [[Hylia]] will guide him.{{Cite|Offer {{Color BotW|Red|Dinraal's scale}}, received from the red spirit, to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Spring of Power}}. I, Goddess Hylia, will guide you.|Spring of Power Statue|BotW}} [[Dinraal]] flies through [[Eldin's Flank]] and the [[Tanagar Canyon]]. Link can obtain one of its Scales by shooting an [[Arrow]] at its body. Once he has obtained a Scale, Link can return to offer it to the Spring of Power by dropping it in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. When he does, the entryway behind the Spring of Power Statue will open, allowing access to [[Tutsuwa Nima Shrine]], and Hylia encourages him to move forward.{{Cite|Your path has shown itself. Now go forth.|Spring of Power Statue|BotW}} This completes the Shrine Quest. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You learned of a legend that says to offer a {{Color BotW|Red|sacred relic}} to the {{Color BotW|Red|Spring of Power}}, located to the {{Color BotW|Red|west}} of East Akkala Stable.

The legend didn't say what this {{Color BotW|Red|sacred relic}} might be. |- | 2 | You found the {{Color BotW|Red|Spring of Power}} and heard the Goddess's voice: "Offer {{Color BotW|Red|Dinraal's scale}} received from the red spirit to the Spring of Power."

Does this mean that the sacred relic is {{Color BotW|Red|Dinraal's scale}}? Who or what is Dinraal? |- | Complete | "Offer Dinraal's scale received from the red spirit to the Spring of Power."

When you carried out the statue's suggestion and dropped Dinraal's scale into the Spring of Power, an ancient shrine revealed itself.

So the sacred relic was indeed Dinraal's scale... }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Tutsuwa Nima Shrine.png|Tutsuwa Nima Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Dinraal * East Akkala Stable * Nobo * Spring of Power * Tutsuwa Nima Shrine }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
